headline: Warren Buffett Pledges $5.5 Billion in Berkshire Hathaway Shares
summary: Warren Buffett pledged to donate roughly US$5.5 billion worth of Berkshire Hathaway stock to his family's philanthropic foundations, marking his largest annual Thanksgiving donation and advancing plans to give away his wealth.
why: Berkshire Hathaway is a diversified multinational conglomerate holding major investments across insurance, railways, utilities, and consumer brands.

impacts.name: Berkshire Hathaway
impacts.why: The donation represents a transfer of shares into philanthropic foundations as part of Buffett's succession plan.
